user_query: I'm organizing a language exchange program and need translation services. Can you help me translate the phrase 'What is your name?' into French, Spanish, and German? Additionally, I would like to translate the sentence 'I love learning new languages' into Old English to add a unique touch to the program.

TaskList.description: Translate the phrase 'What is your name?' into French.
Translate the phrase 'What is your name?' into Spanish.
Translate the phrase 'What is your name?' into German.
Translate the sentence 'I love learning new languages' into Old English.
